text:
Customer: the monthly export fails with "timeout after 300s".
Agent (Mon): asked for the job ID and log. Customer: job ID is EXP-4471.
Agent (Tue): reran the export manually, it failed at the same step.
Agent (Tue): asked the platform team to raise the timeout.

Customer: printer on floor 2 shows offline for everyone.
Agent: restarted the print spooler on the print server, no change.
Agent: checked the switch port, link is up.
Agent: needs a technician to look at the printer on site.

Customer: password reset email never arrives.
Agent: asked customer to check spam, nothing there.
Agent: resent the reset from the admin console twice, still nothing.
Agent: mail admin must check the mailbox delivery logs.

Customer: VPN drops every 15 minutes on the home network.
Agent: had the customer reinstall the VPN client, no change.
Agent: collected the client log and attached it.
Agent: network team to review the gateway log for the session.

Customer: laptop battery lasts under an hour.
Agent: ran battery diagnostics, health reports 38 percent.
Agent: updated the BIOS, no change.
Agent: raise a warranty replacement for the battery.

Customer: needs access to the Projects SharePoint site.
Agent: checked, the site needs approval from the site owner.
Agent: sent the request to the customer's manager for sign-off.
Agent: waiting for the manager's approval before granting access.

Customer: VPN will not connect since this morning.
Agent: VPN client reinstalled, works now.
Customer: also, the office printer prints blank pages.
Agent: replaced the toner, still blank; the drum may be faulty.

Customer: the report export failed yesterday.
Agent: cleared the stuck job and re-ran it, export completed.
Customer: confirmed, the file arrived and looks correct.
Agent: no further action needed.

Customer: I cannot open the sales report.
Agent: will look into it.
expected_points: report;unclear|nothing has been tried|no steps|not been tried|no troubleshooting
